items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So I called him and left a message. He didn’t call me back.

ctx.x: So he brings in people who play his sound, what he hears.
And a musician. I just heard a record the night. It shook me up. I was listening to Sirius, and they played his concert, and he played “Blues Walk,” featuring Sherman.
